title: Retain best Reference candidate after bounded fidelity retries
description: Three distinct live Reference jobs terminated together with 'Reference-pack fidelity quality review failed'. Concurrent distinct jobs keep independent assessment/retry/ranking state; shared reviewer scheduling may align completion times but never verdicts. Update obsolete route assertions and add 3-job concurrency, reviewer-unavailable/malformed, privacy/recovery/progress tests and full gates.

title: Add private owner messaging with local triage and safe output attachments
description: Add an in-app compose flow that can privately deliver a message to a server-configured owner destination without exposing the destination address to the browser, sender, public APIs, logs, queue metadata, or tracked source. acceptance_criteria: Threat model and tests cover private destination/credential non-disclosure; authenticated/rate-limited composition; authorized attachment selection across outputs/components/Reference artifacts; bounded MIME/count/size/archive rules; local malware scanner unavailable/infected fail-closed; local LLM unavailable/unsafe/unhelpful decisions with clear user-visible reasons and owner override policy; explicit/profane content remains content-neutral; delivery idempotency/retry; no raw body/media/path in logs or public job state; transport and provider disclosure; successful receipt without recipient address.

Tests cover header injection, Unicode/control characters, bounce/DMARC failure, unverified alias rejection, Reply-To visibility in sender confirmation, and receipt privacy.

comments.text: Local triage model policy: never use a tiny/low-capability classifier merely for latency. Server declares an exact minimum capability/context/quality floor and chooses content-neutrally from compatible local models: prefer an already resident model; else a model that an earlier queued job is scheduled to make resident and wait behind that exact residency transition; else enqueue a low-priority load only if it will not preempt/disrupt higher-priority work. Seal chosen model/provider/version and residency decision. Expose bounded queued/waiting/triaging state and reason. On timeout/unavailability, retain a private draft/pending-triage state; do not silently downshift or send content to a remote provider. Tests cover stale residency, cancelled predecessor, queue reorder, timeout, starvation bound, exact-model drift, and no duplicate load.

comments.author: HaileyStorm

UI shows why an identity is unavailable without exposing transport configuration or the private destination.

Reuse the authoritative scheduler/resource descriptor; do not infer safety from GPU-only occupancy. Pause/requeue on pressure or model-load contention, yield to interactive/generation work, and expose waiting/running reason. Tests cover opportunistic overlap, already-resident fast path, queued residency, CPU/RAM/I/O revocation, no duplicate load, and starvation bound.

title: Add public-safe live development status pill
description: When Maestro is online and active maintenance/development is underway, show a compact non-obstructive but discoverable public-safe status pill. The concise current summary may expand on hover/focus/click to bounded Recently completed and Up next entries. Reuse the restart/offline public-status store and local/LAN/Cloudflare projection rather than creating a second status system.
acceptance_criteria: Only explicitly public entries are shown; never derive directly from Beads, git diff/status, prompts, jobs, logs, paths, private projects/media, messages/email, credentials, or agent transcripts. Entries have closed category, bounded copy, issued/updated/expiry timestamps, visibility flag, and generation token. Heartbeat/expiry removes stale 'working now' state after crash. Owner/local agent can publish/clear/privatize; remote cannot mutate. Online pill and offline page agree, escape content, are no-store/cache-busted appropriately, support keyboard/screen readers/mobile/4K, and have local/LAN/Cloudflare parity plus disabled/generic fallback.

comments.author: HaileyStorm
comments.text: ETA UX: compact current pill includes one rough owner/agent-supplied ETA range or coarse phrase, e.g. '~20–40 min' or 'later today'; expanded Up next entries may do the same. Use a single unobtrusive Estimate label, not repeated disclaimers. Persist estimate issued/updated/expiry plus optional range bounds; refresh with heartbeat, clear when stale, and record a bounded changed-at indicator when materially revised. Never derive precision from token counts or expose internal agent timing.

comments.author: HaileyStorm
comments.text: Public-safe means intentionally appropriate/useful for ordinary users, not merely secret-free. Every entry requires a separately authored public_summary plus explicit audience=public; never derive from internal issue titles/comments. Hard-exclude break-glass/admin controls, auth/security hardening details, vulnerabilities/abuse controls, private messaging destination/config, credentials, internal cleanup targets, unpublished provider/model/security limitations, and other owner-only capabilities even if text is sanitized. Appropriate categories include visible UX/features, model support, planned maintenance, and shipped user-facing fixes. Tests use adversarial harmless-sounding admin items to prove exclusion.

comments.author: HaileyStorm
comments.text: Audience policy also governs curated changelog, What's new, version history, release notes, roadmap, and update notifications. Public surfaces consume only explicit audience=public summaries; admin/security/private operational items remain in private audit/owner history. If source/Git history is later public, it is not a secrecy boundary and must contain no secrets, but curated product history remains intentionally filtered and must not automatically mirror commit/Beads text.

comments.author: HaileyStorm
comments.text: Lightweight ETA calibration: retain public-safe work category, initial range, material range revisions, started/finished timestamps, and delivered/not-delivered outcome. Maintain a small recency-weighted rolling error/calibration per category to adjust and widen future ranges when evidence is sparse; owner/agent estimate remains authoritative. No task-content history, prompt/token telemetry, complex ML, or false minute precision. Tests cover first-sample fallback, early/late delivery, cancelled/blocked exclusion, range revision, drift/recency, bounded storage, and stable public copy.
